chars.T: TAREK: a slightly chubby young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a black call-center headset hanging around his neck, dark blue jeans, white sneakers.
chars.S: SOFIA: a slim young woman wearing a lilac blazer over a white top, black trousers, a small beige handbag on her shoulder.
chars.A: AMINE: a tall muscular young man wearing a black leather jacket over a white t-shirt, grey joggers, a thin gold chain.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening in Casablanca outside a modern glass office building. AMINE leans on a shiny black car parked at the curb, arms crossed, glaring angrily. In the middle distance TAREK and SOFIA walk out of the building entrance side by side, smiling, not yet seeing him.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of TAREK standing frozen on the sidewalk outside the office building at dusk, eyes wide, sweating, clutching the strap of his backpack, nervous like a scared schoolboy.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SOFIA stops suddenly on the sidewalk, hand over her mouth, panicking, eyes darting; TAREK next to her looks at her confused. Office building and street lights behind them.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AMINE standing next to his black car on a Casablanca street at dusk, jaw clenched, staring hard forward with jealousy and anger, fists tight.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: AMINE walks slowly and menacingly toward TAREK and SOFIA on the sidewalk in front of the office building; TAREK steps back nervously, SOFIA looks down ashamed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AMINE stands right in front of TAREK on the sidewalk, pointing a finger at his chest, asking him aggressively; TAREK nods nervously. Evening street, cars and street lamps behind.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Tense face-to-face: AMINE leans in very close to TAREK, staring him dead in the eyes with a threatening look; TAREK leans back, scared. Side view, both full body, evening street.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: AMINE puts a heavy hand on TAREK's shoulder and squeezes it, smiling coldly; TAREK stiff and sweating. Office building entrance behind them, evening.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: AMINE turns his head away from TAREK to stare coldly at SOFIA; SOFIA covers her face with her hands, ashamed, wishing to disappear; TAREK stands frozen between them. Evening sidewalk in Casablanca.
